findings.issue: Dev Caddyfile defines a separate chat-api.mainecybertech.us subdomain virtual host; prod Caddyfile.prod has no API subdomain
findings.impact: The separate API subdomain bypasses the same-origin architecture for cookie visibility. SameSite=Strict cookies won't be sent to the API subdomain, breaking auth.
findings.fix: Remove chat-api.mainecybertech.us virtual host from dev Caddyfile. Route API traffic through chat.mainecybertech.us/v1/* matching prod topology. Update API_BASE_URL in deploy-development.yml.

findings.issue: Dev compose missing LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, LIVEKIT_HOST env vars on api service; prod compose includes all three
findings.impact: Dev environment will either crash or silently disable WebRTC features. Developers testing on dev may get different behavior than production.
findings.fix: Add LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, LIVEKIT_HOST=http://livekit:7880 to dev compose api service environment mirroring prod configuration.

findings.issue: Dev deployment writes NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and API_BASE_URL pointing to different subdomains; prod follows same pattern with .com TLD
findings.impact: Mixed API URL configuration creates two divergent code paths for API access. Cookies set by main domain won't be sent to API subdomain.
findings.fix: Use a single canonical API URL. Set both NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and API_BASE_URL to https://chat.mainecybertech.us. Remove API subdomain routing entirely.

findings.issue: Dev livekit turn domain hardcoded to 'localhost'; prod livekit uses DOMAIN env var (chat.mainecybertech.com)
findings.impact: Mobile or remote clients connecting to dev environment will fail TURN connectivity. WebRTC/media features cannot be validated on dev before prod deployment.
findings.fix: Parametrize livekit turn domain in dev compose using ${DOMAIN:-localhost} to match prod pattern.

findings.issue: Dev Caddyfile uses local filesystem TLS certs; prod uses Cloudflare origin certificates at different paths
findings.impact: Dev and prod have different cert paths (/etc/caddy/certs/ vs /certs/), creating confusion for debugging certificate issues.
findings.fix: Align cert mount points and naming between dev and prod compose files using consistent paths.
